resources.string: Pick a .txt or .pdf; you get a translated file in the same format (2 MB).
Pick or take a photo; the translation is drawn onto it.
The model downloads once; afterwards the app works offline.
Wergêr is a free, open-source translation app. It translates Kurdish (Kurmancî and Soranî) and many other languages, both offline and online. We believe no language should be left behind.
Open source · Free · No ads · No tracking
Built with ONNX Runtime, ML Kit, pdf.js and pdf-lib — thanks to the open-source community.
In offline mode text never leaves your device. In online mode text is sent to translation services.

Wergêr translates between Kurdish (Kurmancî & Soranî), Turkish, Persian, Arabic, English and about 200 more languages — as plain text, inside photos, and inside documents. This guide walks you through each feature. You can reopen it any time from the Guide button.
On the Translate screen, choose the source and target languages at the top. Type or paste your text, then press Translate. Use ⇄ to swap the two languages, 🔊 to listen, and ⧉ to copy the result.

Open the Photo tab and choose an image. Wergêr reads the text in the picture, translates it, and paints the translation back over the original — like a live camera translator. Switch between the original and the translation, view it fullscreen, then Save or Share it.

Open the Document tab and pick a .txt or .pdf file (up to 2 MB). Text files are translated line by line. PDFs keep their original layout — every page is translated in place. When it finishes you can scroll through all the pages, then Save the file to your device or Share it.

Auto mode uses the internet when available and falls back to offline automatically. Online is fast and needs no setup. Offline works with no connection once you download the NLLB language models in Settings — ideal for privacy or travel.

Offline translation never leaves your device. Online translation sends only the text you are translating to the translation service. Wergêr has no ads, no tracking and no account. Made by Cybergah Group.
